abstract: The distribution of EcoR1 and HindIII restriction fragment length polymorphisms in the region of the gene coding for the alpha subunit of human chorionic gonadotrophin have been examined in 71 normal controls, six families, and 65 cases of hydatidiform mole, all of European origin. In control samples the genotypes generated by the presence or absence of the restriction sites, fitted a Hardy Weinberg distribution while in family studies the two polymorphisms showed Mendelian inheritance. The distribution of the genotypes in hydatidiform moles differed from that in control samples. However, the frequency of the alternative alleles R+, R- and H+, H- was not significantly different in the two populations and differences in the distribution of genotypes could be explained in terms of the unique origin of hydatidiform moles. The frequency of the rare homozygous genotype R-R-,H+H+, which has previously been suggested to be associated with the development of choriocarcinoma, was similar in those complete moles which resolved spontaneously (35 per cent) and those which progressed to trophoblastic tumours (27 per cent). No association was found between the genotype of the hydatidiform mole and the subsequent clinical outcome of the patient. Thus the pattern of restriction fragment length polymorphisms associated with the human chorionic gonadotrophin alpha subunit gene would not appear to be an appropriate marker of clinical outcome in patients with hydatidiform moles.
abstract_ja: 欧州系の対照71例、家系6組、胞状奇胎65例について、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)α鎖遺伝子領域のEcoR1およびHindIII制限酵素断片長多型の分布を検討した。対照試料の遺伝子型は、制限部位の有無により生じるものがハーディ・ワインベルグ分布に適合し、家系研究では2つの多型がメンデル遺伝を示した。胞状奇胎における遺伝子型の分布は対照試料と異なっていた。しかし、対立遺伝子R+、R-およびH+、H-の頻度は両集団間で有意差がなく、遺伝子型分布の違いは胞状奇胎の特異な起源で説明できた。絨毛癌との関連がこれまでに示唆されていた稀なホモ接合体遺伝子型R-R-,H+H+の頻度は、自然寛解した完全奇胎(35%)と栄養膜細胞性腫瘍へ進展した例(27%)で類似していた。胞状奇胎の遺伝子型と患者の臨床経過との間に関連は認められなかった。したがって、hCGα鎖遺伝子に関連する制限断片長多型のパターンは、胞状奇胎患者の臨床転帰のマーカーとして適切ではないと考えられる。
